class: A site's own instruction to enter "Other" for a school its list lacks was recognised by two sentence wordings, not by what the sentence asks for
fix: sites/workday.education_text_offers_other asks whether the Education text tells the applicant to type, search or select a quoted "Other" (any verb form, any quote style), and keeps the two older 'not listed' / 'cannot find' wordings; WorkdayAdapter._school_names uses it as the only place that decides. WorkdayAdapter._education_text reads the section by its group name, else by the block holding its heading; both the Other rule and the 'press Enter to search' rule use it. _school_names then offers 'Other Institution - <the school's country>' (country and its ISO spellings from the owner's education details) before plain Other. select_from_searchable_input presses Enter for Field of Study when no visible row matches the typed name. select_from_button_dropdown closes any open list first, clicks through an overlay if one stays, and reads only the rows of the list the button opened (aria-controls, else a listbox that is not an 'items selected' list).
prevention: A site's escape hatch is recognised by the action it asks for, never by the sentence that leads up to it; one function owns the rule and a parametrized test lists every wording met so far.
root_cause: _school_names added the "Other" candidate only when the Education text matched 'not listed' or 'cannot find' followed by select/search 'other' (f281, f282). Analog Devices words it 'does not appear in the pre-populated list ... type "Other," press Enter', so the second Education entry (JNTU Hyderabad) searched for the school alone, found nothing for about a minute three times, and left the School box open so the Degree and Field of Study that followed failed too. Second cause behind the first: the section was looked up as a group NAMED Education, but Analog Devices draws a bare group (a heading and its text, no accessible name), so the section's text was empty and no wording could have matched. Third cause: Analog Devices has no row called Other; typing it offers 'Other Institution - <Country>' for each country (the 'select the appropriate country' of the instruction), so even a found Other matched no row. Fourth cause (Field of Study): its list returns only the first 100 rows alphabetically until Enter submits the search, so a subject past them (Electrical Engineering) never appeared; the first entry's Computer Science sits in the first hundred, so only the second entry failed. Fifth cause (Degree): the Field of Study list stayed open over the Degree button, so the plain click timed out five times; and the dropdown read every role=option on the page, including the School's 'items selected' row ('Available: [Eastern Illinois University]').
symptom: Run stuck on My Experience: Education 2 School search failed after ~50 s, then Degree and Field of Study failed (~40 s and ~60 s), repeated on every pass.
why_tests_missed: Each earlier fix added a test for the one wording just met; none enumerated the ways a tenant can say 'enter Other', so the third wording failed the same way. Every fixture gave the section an aria-label, which the real page does not have. The browser fixtures offered a row literally named Other. No fixture had a list that filters only on Enter. No fixture left another list open over the button or put chosen-value options before the popup's.
